settings.title: Settings
settings.reddit.title: Reddit
settings.reddit.intro: Reddit needs an OAuth app. Registration is not self-service and approval takes two to four weeks, so register early.
settings.reddit.secretPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the stored secret
settings.reddit.notConfigured: Not configured. Reddit sources stay inactive until a client id and secret are set.
settings.reddit.envOverrides: REDDIT_CLIENT_ID and REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET are set in the environment and take precedence. Editing these fields will not change which credentials are used.
settings.reddit.budget: Budget: {remaining} requests left, window resets in {resetIn}s.
settings.nitter.title: X via Nitter
settings.nitter.intro: X support is best-effort. The official API has no free tier, so this goes through a self-hosted Nitter instance. List instances in order, self-hosted first.
settings.nitter.urls: Instance base URLs, one per line
settings.nitter.usingEnv: Using NITTER_BASE_URLS from the environment. Saving here overrides it.
settings.nitter.none: No instance configured. X sources stay inactive until one is set.
settings.nitter.allFailed: No instance is working. X sources will fail until one is.

theme.preset.default.note: Colours derived from the accent below.
theme.preset.solarized.note: Ethan Schoonover's hues. Adapted: the original puts its light body text at 4.13:1, below this app’s 4.5:1 floor, so the lightness is adjusted.
theme.preset.terminal.note: Green phosphor. The light variant is the same green on paper.
theme.preset.vt220.note: DEC amber phosphor. The light variant is amber on paper.
theme.preset.powershell.note: The console navy #012456 with its off-white text and warning yellow.
theme.accent.ignoredByPreset: {preset} sets its own colours, so the accent has no effect.

auth.password.hint: At least {min} characters. Length matters more than punctuation.
auth.password.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
auth.password.changed: Password changed. {count} other sessions were signed out.
auth.sessions.title: Active sessions
settings.alerts.title: Alerts
settings.alerts.intro: Where matching items get pushed. Alerts always appear in the dashboard; this is the extra copy sent somewhere you will actually see it.
settings.alerts.hint.ntfy: The full topic URL. Self-hosted or ntfy.sh — a topic name is the only secret, so make it long.
settings.alerts.hint.gotify: The complete endpoint including the token. Nothing is appended to what you paste.
settings.alerts.hint.discord: A channel webhook URL, from Channel settings > Integrations.
settings.alerts.hint.generic: Receives a POST with the whole batch as JSON.
settings.alerts.testOk: Sent. If it did not arrive, the target accepted it and dropped it.
settings.alerts.noneNote: Alerts are collected in the dashboard only. Nothing is pushed anywhere.
widget.custom_api.empty: Nothing came back, or the mapping selected nothing. Use Preview to see what the endpoint returns.
widget.custom_api.params: Query parameters, one per line as name: value
widget.custom_api.headers: Headers, one per line as Name: value
widget.custom_api.headers.hint: ${VAR} is replaced from the server environment. A missing variable is an error, not an empty string.
widget.custom_api.root: Root path (JSONPath) — where the array is
widget.custom_api.fields: Field mapping, one per line as name: $.path
widget.custom_api.fields.hint: title is required; url, subtitle, timestamp and value are optional. An entry with no title is dropped.
tags.intro: Tags group sources. A widget or a rule can then filter on a tag rather than on a list of sources.
tags.add.title: Add a tag
sources.intro: Feeds, subreddits and X accounts. Everything lands in one item store and is scored by the same rules.
sources.add.title: Add a source
sources.add.intro: Paste a feed URL, a blog address, r/subreddit or an @handle. The preview shows real items before anything is saved.
sources.list.title: Tracked sources
settings.retention.intro: How long items are kept. The nightly purge runs at 03:00.
settings.retention.starredNote: Starred items are never deleted, however old.
